length_cue_no_model_s2.note: These use NO model. Natural prompt tokens come from control-modernbert-base, which ran cap_tokens 6144 with shrunk == 0, so its input_tokens is the untruncated prompt length.

length_cue_no_model_s3.note: No negative control was run on s3, so no untruncated token count exists there. context_bytes and context_events are corpus-level and model-independent, so they are the honest length proxies on s3. The s2 length control uses natural prompt tokens (primary) and context_bytes (cross-check).
